title: Low Dose Dasatinib (50 mg Daily) as First-line Treatment for Newly Diagnosed Chronic-Phase Chronic Myeloid Leukemia

sections.abstract: The purpose of this multicenter randomized study is to compare efficacy and safety of dasatinib 50 mg once daily and dasatinib 100 mg once daily in patients with early chronic phase (CP) chronic myeloid leukemia (CML)
